verseOfTheDay.sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
verseOfTheDay.transliteration:
karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana |
mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stvakarmaṇi ||
verseOfTheDay.english: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of actions. Never consider yourself to be the cause of the results of your activities, nor be attached to inaction.
verseOfTheDay.theme: Focus on the Process, Release Anxiety of Outcome

thoughtOfTheDay.title: Abhyasa and Vairagya (Practice and Detachment)
thoughtOfTheDay.quote: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते — The restless mind is curbed by relentless practice and non-attachment.
thoughtOfTheDay.reflection: Skill in engineering and peace in life do not arrive magically; they are forged through daily incremental practice (abhyasa) and the courage to release non-essential drama (vairagya).

dailyMantra.name: Shanti Patha (Universal Peace Invocations)
dailyMantra.sanskrit: ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय। मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय। ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
dailyMantra.transliteration: oṁ asato mā sad gamaya | tamaso mā jyotir gamaya | mṛtyor mā amṛtaṁ gamaya | oṁ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
dailyMantra.meaning: Lead me from ignorance to Truth; lead me from darkness to Light; lead me from mortality to Immortality. Om, Peace, Peace, Peace.
dailyMantra.benefit: Sets a serene tone for the entire morning, cleansing anxiety and restlessness.
